data.name: Page_Description
data.value: Describe what a good item looks like for your build. After that, every item you copy in game is judged against it.

data.name: Options_Help
data.value: Everything in this section is off by default — a feature only loads its data file when you switch it on.

data.name: Option_CraftCost_Help
data.value: Needs affix-pool-coe.json (~0.75 MB) and affix-types.json; while it is off this panel stays hidden and those files are never read.

data.name: Option_PobEngine_Help
data.value: Once on, the overlay shows an equip & compare panel: the item you copy is put into the build's PoB file and the engine recomputes DPS / EHP against it. The engine ships with this build under pob2\ next to the app (or you can put it in %APPDATA%\sidekick\pob2\); if it can't be found the panel says the engine is unavailable. The switch is live: no restart needed — the engine cold-starts on first use (a few seconds), and switching it off shuts the helper process down and frees its memory, so switching it back on cold-starts again.

data.name: Pob_Absolute_Caveat
data.value: Absolute numbers are only a reference (the engine is a simulator — a wrong config skews them); the difference between two items is what you can trust.

data.name: Pob_Unmapped
data.value: ⚠ our converter didn't recognise {0} affix(es) - they never made it into the calculation, so the numbers may be off.

data.name: Affix_Gain_Help
data.value: How to read this: each number is what that one affix is worth right now — the item is re-run with that single line removed. It is NOT how much more you would gain by rolling it up to the top tier, and the rows must not be added up (bonuses to the same stat stack, 'more' multipliers are independent) — their sum is not the item's total change.

data.name: Affix_Gain_No_Line

data.name: Basket_Gains_None

data.name: Basket_Note_Additive
